headline: F1 A total income of exactly BZ$29,000 is chargeable with no basic deduction: tax BZ$7,250, against BZ$0 at 28,999 and BZ$1 at 29,001

scale.source: Income and Business Tax Act Cap. 55 s. 16(2) as replaced by Act 40 of 2024: total income 'less than twenty nine thousand dollars shall not be chargeable'
scale.basis: Income and Business Tax Act Cap. 55 s. 16(2) as replaced by Act 40 of 2024: total income 'less than twenty nine thousand dollars shall not be chargeable'. A statutory amount, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income and Business Tax Act (Cap. 55)' confirmed and updated: from 1 January 2025 (Act 40 of 2024) employed persons pay 25 % on total income less a 20,000 basic deduction once total income exceeds 29,000, with a phase-in credit of 2,250 - 75 % x (income - 29,000) up to 32,000; no income tax on other persons' chargeable income (business tax instead); Social Security Table 2 (from 6 Jan 2020) weekly contributions, insurable earnings capped at $480 a week.
